Conversation marker

Source: R/tier1-marker.R
shad_marker.Rd

An inline marker row for chat transcripts: status notes, date dividers, and streaming ("thinking") labels. Part of the chat/AI kit.

Usage

shad_marker(
  label,
  icon = NULL,
  variant = c("default", "border", "separator"),
  streaming = FALSE,
  class = NULL,
  ...
)

Arguments

label

The marker text.

icon

Optional shad_icon() name or a tag, shown before the label (omitted for variant = "separator" unless supplied).

variant

One of "default" (inline row), "border" (adds a bottom rule), "separator" (centred label with divider lines on both sides).

streaming

If TRUE, adds a shimmer sweep over the text and role="status" so updates are announced politely.

class

Extra CSS classes.

...

Extra attributes on the root.

Value

A marker tag.

See also

Other shadshiny chat components: shad_attachment(), shad_bubble(), shad_message(), shad_message_spinner()

Examples

shad_marker("Conversation started at 9:41 AM", icon = "clock")
#> <div class="shad-marker shad-marker--default">
#>   <span class="shad-marker__icon" aria-hidden="true"><svg class="shad-icon" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" aria-hidden="true"><circle cx="12" cy="12" r="10"/><polyline points="12 6 12 12 16 14"/></svg></span>
#>   <span class="shad-marker__content">Conversation started at 9:41 AM</span>
#> </div>
shad_marker("Today", variant = "separator")
#> <div class="shad-marker shad-marker--separator">
#>   <span class="shad-marker__content">Today</span>
#> </div>
shad_marker("Thinking...", streaming = TRUE)
#> <div class="shad-marker shad-marker--default shad-marker--shimmer" role="status">
#>   <span class="shad-marker__content">Thinking...</span>
#> </div>
